summary: Reviewed 14 units of RV 2.35. Total issues: 3 error, 34 minor. Errors: unit 7 sudughā rendered passive 'easily milked' (Hindi, English, gloss) instead of active 'good-milking'. Minor: bhuvana 'beings' vs 'world' (units 2, 7), svar left as 'heaven'/'स्वर्', bracketed interpretations in Hindi (units 12, 13), invented splits (haviḥ-bhiḥ, samittha), niṣadya vs printed niṣadyā, gram slips (joṣiṣat 'fut.', dhayati √dhā, asṛkṣi in three readings), '१' accent mark wrongly raised as a digit flag in unit 7, refrain and maghavan wording in unit 14, additions ('his ridge'). Regrouping suggested: unit 7 holds two verses (7ab = 2.35.7, 7cd = 2.35.8) and should be split. Confidences honest.
